steps.title: The curves
steps.say: Demand slopes down: the higher the price, the less buyers want. Supply slopes up: the higher the price, the more sellers offer.

steps.title: Starting equilibrium
steps.say: The curves cross at price 5 and quantity 5. This is the market before anything changes.

steps.title: Demand rises
steps.say: More buyers want the good at every price, so the demand curve moves right. At the old price of 5, buyers now want more than sellers offer.

steps.title: Why the price rises
steps.say: The shortage pushes the price up. As the price rises, buyers want less and sellers offer more, until they meet at a higher price and a higher quantity.

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.say: Drag the demand curve or the supply curve and watch where the new equilibrium lands. What happens to the price if supply rises instead?
